codex.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy node -e 'const f=require(\"node:fs\"),p=require(\"node:path\"),a=require(\"node:assert/strict\"),h=require(\"node:crypto\").createHash(\"sha256\"),c=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(\"config.json\")); a.equal(c.localRoots.length,1); a.equal(c.network,undefined); const root=f.realpathSync(c.localRoots[0]); for(const i of c.inputs){a.equal(i.uri,undefined);a.ok(p.resolve(i.path).startsWith(root+p.sep));a.ok(f.realpathSync(i.path).startsWith(root+p.sep));a.ok(f.statSync(i.path).isFile());h.update(f.readFileSync(i.path));} const walk=d=>{for(const n of f.readdirSync(d).sort()){const q=p.join(d,n);if(f.lstatSync(q).isDirectory())walk(q);else h.update(q).update(f.readFileSync(q));}}; walk(\"interrupted\"); h.update(f.readFileSync(\"config.json\")); console.log(h.digest(\"hex\"));'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy node -e 'const f=require(\"node:fs\"),p=require(\"node:path\"),a=require(\"node:assert/strict\"),h=require(\"node:crypto\").createHash(\"sha256\"),c=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(\"config.json\")); for(const i of c.inputs)h.update(f.readFileSync(i.path)); const walk=d=>{for(const n of f.readdirSync(d).sort()){const q=p.join(d,n);if(f.lstatSync(q).isDirectory())walk(q);else h.update(q).update(f.readFileSync(q));}}; walk(\"interrupted\"); h.update(f.readFileSync(\"config.json\")); a.equal(h.digest(\"hex\"),\"8cbba539e33c079c6b78eac8c74a49749d061e2ccd14cb2f5f8991b2760e4f77\"); const read=x=>JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(x));const rows=x=>f.readFileSync(x,\"utf8\").trim().split(\"\\n\").map(JSON.parse);const old=read(\"interrupted/run.json\"),run=read(\"recovered/run.json\"),v=read(\"recovered-validation.json\"), cov=v.coverage; a.equal(run.parentRunId,old.runId);a.equal(run.configHash,old.configHash);a.deepEqual(rows(\"recovered/inventory.jsonl\").map(x=>x.itemId).sort(),rows(\"interrupted/inventory.jsonl\").map(x=>x.itemId).sort()); const ev=d=>new Set(rows(d+\"/evidence.jsonl\").filter(x=>x.kind===\"content\").map(x=>x.itemId)).size;const checks=rows(\"recovered/checks.jsonl\");const tally=checks.reduce((o,x)=>(o[x.status]=(o[x.status]||0)+1,o),{});console.log(JSON.stringify({valid:v.valid,completionAllowed:v.completionAllowed,errors:v.errors,oldCollected:ev(\"interrupted\"),collected:ev(\"recovered\"),count:cov.total,states:cov.states,dimensions:cov.dimensions,missing:cov.missingChecks.length,queue:cov.pendingQueueCount,inventoryComplete:cov.inventoryComplete,checks:checks.length,tally,completedRules:[...new Set(checks.filter(x=>x.status"'!=="unknown").map(x=>x.ruleId))]}));'"'"
